title: Seven-Field Semantic Expansion
what_it_does: Expands the compact route into seven logical fields (namespace, stellar_system, body, root_face, recursive_path, barycentric, shell_epoch) via TokenSemanticResolver plugins with explicit token counts (one token != one field: recursive_path consumes 3 tokens -> 9 octal steps; namespace/system/body/barycentric consume 0). A full certificate expands every field; variable-depth packets omit the compressed epoch. Lossless expand<->compact round-trip. Conforms to semantic_address.schema.json (with shell_epoch $ref).
negative_results: Body and system prefixes may be absent in short local addresses; absent fields take declared defaults and are listed in 'unresolved', never invented.
barycentric is a derived display coordinate, not a measured position; it is not consulted when compacting.
A root_face token outside 0..19 is refused; the conventional epoch metadata is mandatory.

claims.statement: The seven-field semantic address is an exact, reversible re-expression of the compact route.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public routes only; default namespace/system/body labels carry no private narrative.
